insight: The hydration break statistics for Qatar in the 2026 FIFA World Cup reveal an interesting trend, as the team tends to gain momentum after these breaks, with a positive change in momentum per minute in 5 out of 6 instances. On average, Qatar's momentum increases by 0.033 minutes after a hydration break, which can be a significant advantage in a tightly contested match. However, when Qatar is pressing before a hydration break, they tend to lose momentum, as evidenced by a negative change in momentum per minute, which suggests that the team may be exhausting themselves before the break. In contrast, when Qatar is not pressing before a hydration break, they are able to maintain a positive momentum, with an average increase of 0.080 minutes per minute, indicating that the team is able to regroup and refocus during these breaks.
